name: space-factory
description: Cosmic Pulse: 3D space music videos, edited to the beat of the soundtrack

scripts.make: node src/generate-episodes.js && node src/pipeline.js --format compilation --scale 1.3333 --export ./export && node src/pipeline.js --format music-short --export ./export/shorts
scripts.make:preview: node src/generate-episodes.js && node src/pipeline.js --format compilation --scale 0.5 --fps 24 --export ./export-preview && node src/pipeline.js --format music-short --scale 0.5 --fps 24 --export ./export-preview/shorts
